summary: chunter-cb 的账户配置式账户抽象 EIP（EIP-8130）合并为草案，账户为签名密钥配置链上验证器合约。colinlyguo 的 EIP-8151 合并，让 ecRecover 感知 EOA 私钥已停用，同时 EIP-7851 回到 Draft。VitalikButerin 解读 strawmap 的 AA 部分：自 2016 年 EIP-86 起讨论至今，EIP-8141 是解决剩余问题的综合方案。

items.title: 新增 EIP：账户配置式账户抽象
items.note: （chunter-cb）合并：账户为签名密钥配置账户指定的验证器，即定义签名算法的链上合约，由协议执行验证。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Account Abstraction by Account Configuration
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), merged: accounts configure signing keys with account specified verifiers, onchain contracts defining signature algorithms, validated by the protocol.

items.title: VitalikButerin：账户抽象自 2016 年初的 EIP-86 就在讨论，如今 EIP-8141 作为综合方案解决 AA 剩余的所有问题
items.title_en: VitalikButerin: account abstraction has been discussed since EIP-86 in early 2016, and EIP-8141 is the omnibus that solves every remaining AA problem

items.title: 新增 EIP：感知私钥停用的 ecRecover
items.note: （colinlyguo）合并：DAI 等实现 ERC-2612 permit 的不可变 ERC-20 合约依赖 ecRecover 预编译，EOA 停用私钥后仍可能被旧签名授权，需要 ecRecover 感知停用状态；EIP-7851：移回 Draft（colinlyguo）合并。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Private Key Deactivation Aware ecRecover
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), merged: immutable ERC-20s with ERC-2612 permit such as DAI rely on the ecRecover precompile, so a deactivated EOA key could still authorize via old signatures unless ecRecover knows about deactivation; EIP-7851: move to Draft (colinlyguo), merged.

items.title: EIP-7851：移回 Draft
items.note: 新增 EIP：感知私钥停用的 ecRecover（colinlyguo）合并：DAI 等实现 ERC-2612 permit 的不可变 ERC-20 合约依赖 ecRecover 预编译，EOA 停用私钥后仍可能被旧签名授权，需要 ecRecover 感知停用状态；EIP-7851：移回 Draft（colinlyguo）合并。
items.note_en: Add EIP: Private Key Deactivation Aware ecRecover (colinlyguo), merged: immutable ERC-20s with ERC-2612 permit such as DAI rely on the ecRecover precompile, so a deactivated EOA key could still authorize via old signatures unless ecRecover knows about deactivation; EIP-7851: move to Draft (colinlyguo), merged.

summary_en: chunter-cb's Account Abstraction by Account Configuration EIP (EIP-8130) merged as a draft, letting accounts configure onchain verifier contracts for their signing keys. colinlyguo's EIP-8151 merged, making ecRecover aware of deactivated EOA keys, while EIP-7851 returned to Draft. VitalikButerin covered the strawmap's AA section: discussed since EIP-86 in 2016, with EIP-8141 the omnibus that resolves the remaining problems.
